prompt:
A single bunch of ripe dark red wine grapes hanging straight down from a short woody vine stem that enters from the top edge of the frame, seen straight on. The bunch sits in the right half of the picture: its centre is about 69% across from the left and slightly above the vertical middle, and it fills about two thirds of the frame's height. The whole left half of the picture is completely empty, plain background.

Lighting: the grapes are softly lit from behind and from the upper left by a warm golden light, so the thin-skinned berries glow translucent ruby and garnet from within, like stained glass; in several berries the small dark seeds show faintly as shadows inside. A delicate natural bloom on the skins, crisp dewy highlights, rich true-to-life colour.

Background: a flat, even, very dark midnight navy blue (hex #061625) everywhere, with no gradient, no vignette, no table, no floor, no leaves, no other objects, no text, no watermark.

High-end editorial still-life photography, photorealistic, shot on a medium format camera, sharp detail on the berries, calm and quiet mood.
